say:2:1012125001:0.text: Magister! I'm so glad you're back!
say:2:1012125001:0.male: Magister! I'm so glad you're back!
say:2:1012125001:0.female: Magister! I'm so glad you're back!

say:3:1012125002:1.text: Bless Misarte... You returned just in time.
say:3:1012125002:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒保佑……你们回来得真是及时。
say:3:1012125002:1.male: Bless Misarte... You returned just in time.
say:3:1012125002:1.female: Bless Misarte... You returned just in time.

say:7:1012125004:1.text: We're fine, but the villagers are in danger.
say:7:1012125004:1.source_cn: 我们没事，但是村民有危险。
say:7:1012125004:1.male: We're fine, but the villagers are in danger.
say:7:1012125004:1.female: We're fine, but the villagers are in danger.

say:8:1012125005:1.text: There are a couple of <style="highlight">rabid hornleaf bears</style> in the village. They're scattered all over. We need to get rid of them right away!
say:8:1012125005:1.source_cn: 有好几只<style=highlight>发狂的叶角熊...
